title: BKARForestFormula
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the Brydges-Kennedy-Abdesselam-Rivasseau forest interpolation formula: for a finite vertex set V and a C-infinity function rho on the edge-coupling space of the complete graph on V, the value of rho at the all-ones coupling equals the sum, over all acyclic edge subsets (forests) F, of the integral over the unit cube [0,1]^E(F) of the mixed partial derivative of rho in the edge variables of F, evaluated at the path-minimum interpolation point x^F(u); the empty forest contributes rho(0). The flagship theorem is additionally restated Mathlib-only and re-proved in the leanprover/comparator challenge/solution format using Audit/ForestFormula/comparator.json.
